selection.ownership: Agora, Inc. (NASDAQ: API), 2804 Mission College Blvd, Santa Clara, CA 95054, with Shanghai engineering presence. The reviewed edition is the international Console REST API at api.agora.io. Chinese ownership alone does not exclude this global edition. The mainland-China REST host api.sd-rtn.com / Shengwang is a separate edition and is not admitted.

research.searchCoverage: Official Agora Console REST API (HTTPS Basic Auth with Customer ID as username and Customer Secret as password, GET /dev/v1/projects, GET /dev/v1/project, GET /dev/v3/usage), international host api.agora.io versus mainland-China api.sd-rtn.com, Santa Clara operator identity, and dated incident search for Agora.io / Agora Inc security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. 2021 Clubhouse/Stanford Internet Observatory privacy research is historical. No qualifying current unresolved Agora customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.searchCoverage: Official international Console REST API at https://api.agora.io with HTTP Basic Customer ID / Customer Secret was confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Agora, Inc. incidents.finding: Stanford Internet Observatory reported Clubhouse user/chat IDs in plaintext and Agora as Clubhouse backend infrastructure, with China-law assistance concerns. Agora stated it does not route non-Chinese user traffic through China. Historical 2021 research; not a current unresolved Agora customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: Historical Clubhouse-era privacy research, not a 2026 unresolved Agora breach.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage. Chinese ownership alone does not exclude a global edition.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /dev/v1/projects, matching the pinned validator.
Native Basic auth uses http.auth.basic with username {{customerId}} and password {{apiKey}} (Customer Secret).
Native category is messaging (source Communication is not in Rust CATEGORIES; Agora Console manages real-time voice/video projects).

Pinned host is api.agora.io only. Official mainland-China failover host api.sd-rtn.com is not admitted. Writes, certificate mutation, and recording-server POSTs are omitted. Raw JSON is returned under data. Official GET docs copy-paste a 201 success note; the status table allows 200 or 201.
Returns raw Agora {projects:[...]} JSON under data instead of the upstream normalized project wrapper.
projectId maps to official query id; name maps to official query name on GET /dev/v1/project.
Maps to official GET /dev/v3/usage. projectId, fromDate, toDate, and business map to project_id, from_date, to_date, and business. This is account usage reporting, not a billed lookup.
Maps to official POST /dev/v1/project. enableSignKey binds to enable_sign_key.
Maps to official POST /dev/v1/project_status.
Maps to official POST /dev/v1/signkey.
Maps to official POST /dev/v1/reset_signkey.

Maps to official POST /dev/v1/kicking-rule. appId binds to appid.
Maps to official PUT /dev/v1/kicking-rule.
Maps to official DELETE /dev/v1/kicking-rule with JSON body appid and id.
Maps to official GET /dev/v1/channel/{appid}.
Maps to official GET /dev/v1/channel/user/{appid}/{channelName}.
Maps to official GET /dev/v1/channel/user/property/{appid}/{uid}/{channelName}.
